head.t: InHealth wins £23.9m managed MRI service contract at Chelsea and Westminster
head.x: Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust has awarded a fully managed MRI service contract to InHealth Limited, covering its existing imaging department and the new Diagnostic, Treatment and Education Centre.
